description: Searches the Dockyard catalog. Returns short cards (slug, title, category, kind, image). The full description and the deployment plan come from get_app and prepare_deploy.

limit.description: Defaults to 20 when omitted. Values outside 1–50 are rejected.

offset.description: How many cards to skip from the start of the list. Defaults to 0. Negative values are rejected.

query.description: Words from the name, description, image, or category. Every word must match.

name: list_apps
title: Search apps
